weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg0:start–end (t=9–16s): a ranked bar chart of 1983–2023 permafrost temperatures in which every bar has zero length. Only empty tracks and right-hand labels (-8, -6.5, -5, -3.5, -2.3) appear, and Data hops between the empty rows. It repeats the same five numbers the hook chart had just shown.
weakest_scene.root_cause: Negative temperature values were sent to a rank-bar composer that draws magnitude from a zero baseline, so every bar collapses. The scene also restates the hook's data instead of adding a new demonstration.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Replace it with a bespoke thaw scene made of the subject: a cross-section of frozen ground, or a thermometer driven into the permafrost, whose ice level or mercury climbs from -8°C to -2.3°C as Data hacks or drills at the ice with a tool. Show the 0°C thaw line visibly close, and put °C units on every label.
